2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch removes the ability to 'steal' pages from pipe buffers, which was previously used by the splice() system call and vmsplice() function. The changes include removing the try_steal() method from struct pipe_buf_operations and its implementations, as well as the generic_pipe_buf_try_steal() function. Additionally, flags such as PIPE_BUF_FLAG_LRU and PIPE_BUF_FLAG_GIFT are no longer set for stealing purposes. The patch also updates various functions to use generic_pipe_buf_release() instead of page_cache_pipe_buf_release().
